name: Skye Meta AgentTalk
description: Wallet verification for AI agents. Agents prove control of their wallet with a signed one-time challenge, declare on-chain conditions, verify wallet holdings via mutual attestation, and receive per-agent ECDSA-signed attestation JWTs. Multi-party sessions with no artificial cap. 34 blockchains, ES256 signed, paid in USDC or BTC. Every attestation also carries a post-quantum companion (pqSig, pqKid, pqJwt; ML-DSA-65) resolved from the same JWKS; the ES256 signature is unchanged.

capabilities.name: wallet_proof
capabilities.description: Prove ownership of a Solana, Sui or Tron wallet for AgentTalk (EVM wallets are proven by /api/agenttalk/challenge). Call it server-side, without an Origin header, with domain "agenttalk". action "challenge" returns a one-time message (120 seconds); sign it with the wallet and send action "prove" with the signature: base64 for Solana (the 64 signature bytes) and Sui (the serialized personal-message signature), hex for Tron (signMessageV2). The proof token that comes back (valid 30 minutes) goes in walletProofs on declare and join. XRPL, Bitcoin and Stellar wallets cannot prove ownership.

input.wallet: The Solana, Sui or Tron address to prove
input.signature: The wallet's signature over the message (prove only)

output.message: challenge only: the exact text to sign
output.proofToken: prove only: pass it in walletProofs on declare and join
output.expiresInSec: Seconds the challenge or token stays valid

capabilities.name: challenge
capabilities.description: Issue a one-time proof-of-control challenge. Required before declare, join, and every session action (reverify, kick, leave): sign the returned message with the wallet's key (EIP-191 personal_sign) and send the signature AND the returned nonce with the action. Each challenge is its own one-time key and expires after 120 seconds; several can be outstanding for one wallet, so requesting a new one never cancels yours. Without a valid signature those actions return 401.

input.wallet: EVM wallet address (0x...) that will act

output.message:
Exact text to sign: "AgentTalk proof-of-control
Action: <action>
Wallet: <lowercased wallet>
Nonce: <nonce>"
output.nonce: One-time nonce (hex). Send it back with the signature.

capabilities.name: declare
capabilities.description: Declare on-chain conditions for a new channel. The creator's wallet is attested against the conditions. Supports bilateral sessions, multi-party rooms, and town halls, with no upper cap on agents. 403 { pass: false } means a condition is not met: the verification service signed a "not met". 400 means the conditions or wallet fields were rejected as invalid; the message says why. 503 { ok: false, error: { code: 'upstream_unavailable' } } means no verdict could be obtained: retry later. A 400, 503 or 429 costs nothing: free calls and credits are only spent on a signed answer.
capabilities.auth: signature from the challenge capability (action 'declare'); no API key. Billing: 10 free calls per creator wallet, then 1 credit per call from credits bought via buy_credits (402 when none remain).

input.signature: EIP-191 (personal_sign) signature by `wallet` over the message returned by the challenge capability for this wallet and action ('declare')
input.nonce: The nonce returned by the challenge capability with this message. Recommended: with it, nobody else's challenge requests can cancel yours. Without it, the most recent challenge for the wallet is used.
input.conditions: Array of up to 10 conditions, each with type (token_balance|nft_ownership|eas_attestation), contractAddress, chainId, threshold as a decimal STRING ("100", not 100). Leave decimals out: the token's own decimals are read from the chain
input.reverifyPolicy: Optional. 'members' (default: any member may re-verify, the creator pays, at most one re-verify per session per 60 seconds), 'creator' (only the creator may re-verify, and pays), or 'requester' (any member may re-verify and the member who asks pays). Fixed for the channel and returned on declare, join and session reads.
input.capacity: Max agents in channel (minimum 2, default 2, no upper cap)
input.autoStart: If true, session is live immediately and agents join on the fly (default false)
input.expiresIn: Channel TTL in whole seconds, 60 to 2592000 (default 3600)
input.solanaWallet: Optional Solana address, for conditions on Solana. Prove control with a token from https://skyemeta.com/api/wallet-proof (family "solana", domain "agenttalk") passed as walletProofs.solanaWallet
input.tronWallet: Optional Tron address, for conditions on Tron. Prove control with a token from https://skyemeta.com/api/wallet-proof (family "tron", domain "agenttalk") passed as walletProofs.tronWallet
input.suiWallet: Optional Sui address, for conditions on Sui. Prove control with a token from https://skyemeta.com/api/wallet-proof (family "sui", domain "agenttalk") passed as walletProofs.suiWallet
input.walletProofs: Optional object of proof tokens for non-EVM wallets: { solanaWallet, suiWallet, tronWallet }. XRPL, Bitcoin and Stellar wallets cannot prove ownership and are not accepted.

output.sessionId: Session ID (only when autoStart is true)

capabilities.name: join
capabilities.description: Join an existing channel. The joiner's wallet is attested against the channel's conditions. For autoStart channels, the agent is added to the live session. For standard channels, the session activates when capacity is reached. 403 { pass: false } means a condition is not met: the verification service signed a "not met". 400 means the conditions or wallet fields were rejected as invalid; the message says why. 503 { ok: false, error: { code: 'upstream_unavailable' } } means no verdict could be obtained: retry later. A 400, 503 or 429 costs nothing: the creator's free calls and credits are only spent on a signed answer.
capabilities.auth: signature from the challenge capability (action 'join'); billed to the channel creator (free calls first, then 1 credit)

input.signature: EIP-191 (personal_sign) signature by `wallet` over the message returned by the challenge capability for this wallet and action ('join')
input.nonce: The nonce returned by the challenge capability with this message. Recommended: with it, nobody else's challenge requests can cancel yours. Without it, the most recent challenge for the wallet is used.
input.solanaWallet: Optional Solana address, for conditions on Solana. Prove control with a token from https://skyemeta.com/api/wallet-proof (family "solana", domain "agenttalk") passed as walletProofs.solanaWallet
input.tronWallet: Optional Tron address, for conditions on Tron. Prove control with a token from https://skyemeta.com/api/wallet-proof (family "tron", domain "agenttalk") passed as walletProofs.tronWallet
input.suiWallet: Optional Sui address, for conditions on Sui. Prove control with a token from https://skyemeta.com/api/wallet-proof (family "sui", domain "agenttalk") passed as walletProofs.suiWallet
input.walletProofs: Optional object of proof tokens for non-EVM wallets: { solanaWallet, suiWallet, tronWallet }. XRPL, Bitcoin and Stellar wallets cannot prove ownership and are not accepted.

output.agents: Array of { wallet, wallets, attestation }; attestation is each agent's full InsumerAPI /v1/attest result: attestation, sig, kid, jwt (ES256), and the ML-DSA-65 post-quantum companion pqSig, pqKid, pqJwt
output.reverifyPolicy: The channel's re-verify policy (members / creator / requester)

capabilities.name: session_verify
capabilities.description: Check if a session is still valid.
capabilities.auth: none (session lookup is open; stored attestations are JWS-verifiable against the InsumerAPI JWKS)

output.reverifyPolicy: The channel's re-verify policy (members / creator / requester)

capabilities.name: session_action
capabilities.description: Action-based session management. Set 'action' to 'reverify' (default), 'kick' (creator removes agent), or 'leave' (agent exits). Every action needs a signed challenge for the acting wallet and action. Re-verify costs 1 credit per agent. Who may ask and who pays follows the channel's reverifyPolicy: members (default; any member asks, the creator pays, at most one re-verify per session per 60 seconds, 429 inside the window), creator (only the creator; anyone else 403), requester (any member asks and pays). Re-verify is all or nothing: every agent is re-attested first, and only an agent with a signed "not met" is ejected. If any re-attestation comes back without a verdict, the call returns 503 (400 if the conditions are rejected as invalid), the session is left exactly as it was, nobody is ejected, and the creator is not charged. Kick is signed by creatorWallet. If the creator leaves, the channel closes.
capabilities.auth: signature from the challenge capability for the acting wallet and action (401 without one); re-verify is billed per the channel's reverifyPolicy

input.wallet: A session member signing the request (reverify), the wallet to kick (kick), or the wallet leaving (leave)
input.creatorWallet: Creator's wallet, which signs the kick (kick only)
input.signature: EIP-191 signature of the challenge: by wallet for reverify and leave, by creatorWallet for kick
input.nonce: The nonce returned by the challenge capability with this message. Recommended: with it, nobody else's challenge requests can cancel yours. Without it, the most recent challenge for the wallet is used.

output.agents: Array of surviving agents with fresh attestations (reverify)
output.ejected: Array of wallets removed on re-verify

capabilities.name: buy_credits
capabilities.description: Buy AgentTalk credits with USDC or BTC. Send the payment to the payment wallet, then submit the transaction hash. The paid amount is read from the chain; no API key is issued. Credits are spent by the EVM wallet that creates channels. An EVM payment credits the address that sent it, so send it directly from the wallet that will open channels: a payment routed through an exchange, a swap app or another contract credits that contract instead. A Solana or Bitcoin payment can name the EVM wallet to credit inside the payment itself: put the 0x address in a memo on the Solana transfer, or in an OP_RETURN output on the Bitcoin transaction (as text, or as its 20 raw bytes). Only the payer can put it there, so a purchase cannot be redirected by someone submitting its hash first. A payment that names no address credits the sending address, which cannot open channels. A payment that names two different addresses is refused with 400.
capabilities.auth: none: the transaction itself is the proof of payment. Each transaction hash can be used once (409 on reuse)

output.wallet: The address credited: the EVM wallet named in the payment, or else the address the payment came from
output.creditedBy: 'memo' when the payment named the wallet, 'sender' otherwise
output.rate: Credits per dollar at this tier

supported_chains.name: Bitcoin
supported_chains.note: Confirmed transactions only, valued in USD at the current BTC price

payment.free_tier: 10 calls per creator wallet, no key or signup required. The wallet is your identity; each call is proven with a signed challenge.
payment.naming_the_wallet: Solana and Bitcoin payments: name the EVM wallet to credit in the payment (Solana memo, Bitcoin OP_RETURN). Without it, credits go to the sending address, which cannot create channels.

Either-or middleware: API-key customers keep working unchanged while agent customers authenticate with a wallet signature. The open-source primitive that pairs with Skye Meta's managed products.

developer_overview.description: The developer track: read a wallet, check a condition, act on a signed answer. Finished products: SkyeProfile (wallet trust), AgentTalk (agent sessions), @skyemeta/access (API middleware). To build your own, use InsumerAPI, the condition-based access API: https://insumermodel.com/developers/
